guideSection:
## Images you can place

The host registered these images for this document. Place one with `{"type": "image", "src": "image:NAME"}`, in the body or in a header or footer that holds `blocks` (a letterhead puts its logo in `page.header` or `page.firstHeader`). Use only these names: never invent an image, and never write out a data URL for one of them. Each is placed at the size and with the alt text listed; set `widthPx` or `heightPx` on the block to resize it (the other follows the image's shape), or `alt` to describe it differently. Any other `image:` name is refused with `image_unknown`.

- `image:logo`: PNG, 600 x 200 px; placed at 150 x 50 px; alt "Acme Ltd"
- `image:seal`: JPEG, 64 x 48 px
- `image:signature`: PNG, 300 x 100 px; placed 120 px wide; alt "Signature of J. Smith"
schemaSrcDescription: PNG or JPEG data URL, or a registered image by name: image:logo, image:seal, image:signature. Use a registered name rather than inventing an image; any other image: name is refused (image_unknown).

refusals.title: images is not an object of name => image
a name must start with a letter
a name holds letters, digits, - and _ only
a name is at most 64 characters
an image is a string or an object
an object takes data, widthPx, heightPx and alt only
a data URL must be base64
not a data URL, and not PNG or JPEG bytes
a PNG whose size cannot be read
